title: QuickSwitcher
wrapsNative: MonarchBottomSheet (skipPartiallyExpanded) holding MonarchSearchBar (androidx.compose.material3.DockedSearchBar) and MonarchSearchResults (a androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn), opened by a button and by androidx.compose.ui.input.key.onPreviewKeyEvent for Ctrl+K
summary: A recipe, not a component: the CommandPalette recipe preset for jumping to places: type part of a name, tap the match, go there, with recent places first and a search-everywhere fallback.
whenToUse: When people move between many named places (channels, projects, people, documents) and know their names.
whenNotToUse: For running commands such as Create issue use the CommandPalette recipe; for filtering one list use MonarchSearchBar on that screen.
api: MonarchSearchBar(query = query, onQueryChange = { query = it }, onSearch = {}, placeholder = "Jump to…")

MonarchSearchResults(groups = recent while the query is empty, else matches by group plus a Search group, onSelect = { result, _ -> navigate and close }, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f), query = query)
Modifier.onPreviewKeyEvent { event -> event.type == KeyEventType.KeyDown && event.isCtrlPressed && event.key == Key.K }

options.name: destinations
options.type: List of id, label and group
options.description: The places to jump to, each under a group such as Channels, People or Documents; match the query against the label and any keywords.

options.name: recent
options.description: Shown as the Recent group while the query is empty.

options.name: search everywhere
options.description: A last group with "Search for “query”" that opens the full search screen.

options.name: open
options.description: Whether the sheet is shown, kept with rememberSaveable.

options.name: query
options.description: The search text; cleared when the sheet closes.

states.name: closed
states.description: Only the trigger (a button, or a search MonarchIconButton in the top app bar).

states.name: typing
states.description: Matches grouped by kind, then Search for “query”.

states.name: no matches
states.description: Only the search-everywhere fallback, or MonarchSearchResults' empty state without it.

appearance: A Material 3 bottom sheet in the Monarch theme holding the docked search bar and grouped result rows with highlighted matches. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those components.
platformNotes: The web QuickSwitcher is a thin CommandPalette preset in a centered dialog opened with Cmd+K, with arrow keys, Enter and links (href). On a phone it is the CommandPalette recipe's full-height sheet: touch replaces arrow keys, the app navigates in onSelect (components do not navigate), and Ctrl+K works on hardware keyboards only. The web's hotkey prop, custom filter function and footer have no counterpart; sources fetched as you type run in a LaunchedEffect keyed on the query, passing loading to MonarchSearchResults. iOS has no entry yet; its plan is also a recipe.
accessibility: The trigger is a button with a 48dp target.
The sheet is a modal pane; back and the scrim close it.
Group headings are headings and each place is one button, from MonarchSearchResults, which also announces the result count.
Matched words are shown semibold on the match fill by MonarchSearchResults, so a match never rests on color alone.
edgeCases: Never put MonarchSearchResults inside verticalScroll; give it the remaining height with weight(1f).
Clear the query when the sheet closes so the next opening starts with Recent.
Show the search-everywhere fallback only once something is typed.
